correctness.rationale: Independently reconstructed the essential five-state predecessor transducer of the bilateral even shift and exhaustive closed subset-state analysis for all 256 Wolfram rules. Exactly 16 codes give 8 maps (codes differ only on absent triple 101); only six codes, three coordinate shifts, are onto. Language-equality product BFS checked image F_139=F_209 forbidding 000 and 101, and F_222=X additionally forbidding 010 and 0110. Integer characteristic polynomials independently derived for rules 139,209,222, yielding the claimed cubic/quintic Perron roots. Closed state-space reachability is an unrestricted automata proof, unlike finite test words. The strict-sofic image admits arbitrarily long zero-gap parity distinctions.
